Good Evening I know a number of you have made inquiries regarding the Sell Out Hall of Fame inductees allow me to clear some things up ok

@chinaJade you asked where did all the NC ships PAC uses to bribe?
A: They are gotten by PAC Leaders spending LOTS of NC and also from the known ship scammers PAC recruited in the company like Wolf_Fang ChuengPoTsai,Bartolomeo.These guys sole job when recruited is to scam ships and use them to bribe current and prospective memebers. Thank you for asking :)

@MingMei You Said just because PAC lends new players ships to grind it is not a bribe
A:Thank you for your inquiry 1st off PAC does not have any low or mid level people in company so they dont need grind ships, secondly whether you lend or give it is still a bribe as PAC draws you in and keeps you in by letting you use free NC ship or NC items as long as you join or stay in the company. Who wouldnt want to join PAC and sell out if they can get any NC ship they want upon joining for free? Most memebers of PAC have sold out this way ^_^

@Sergent002 you asked if you were bribed why did you leave?
A: You got caught before when you accepted a FIS for joining PAC after you were exposed you left the company due to embarassment.Thnak you for your question :)

@Naoyasu you asked if Bowser still plays?
A: Yes Bowser of PAC still plays he uses the name Yashiru_Kusanagi now and is CO Director of PAC. This is due to him sinking and farming his own company member Lild who quit and came back to PAC after this happened after being promised a MKW. When word got out and people began making fun of those two he paid for a name change. :)

If you have Any Questions about the Sell Out Hall of Fame Please fell free to Ask. Later Sell Outs! :D

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: This is a UWC ship which means it has at some point been present in the Cove shop - players sell them from time to time.

comments.author: dofd
comments.body: Does this mean it can also be available there in the future or not anymore? Sorry for so many questions, I am interested in an unimproved G0 one, but I suppose I cannot find that.

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: It depends on when it was last released, and its supply and demand. Usually the longer it's been since it last came out from the cove, the lower the drop rate, and the higher buy demand from players, the more difficulty you can expect to find one. I don't doubt that PP will likely put this back in the cove at some point, but when exactly remains to be seen...
